day: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: ORIGINAL panoramic architectural background plate for the full-width welcome of a prayer-room guide. Output2048x1024, EXACT2:1 landscape panorama. Build a contemporary quiet public prayer room as editorial architectural photography: precise level camera squarely facing a long rear wall, natural scale and texture, no fisheye. Strong intentional composition: the whole LEFT HALF holds the architecture, entrance and prayer mat; the RIGHT HALF is generous quiet ivory wall and a little floor, intended for separate HTML interface text. On the left, one broad RECTANGULAR floor-to-ceiling glazed opening, internal aperture approximately x=85 to650 and y=175 to790. The opening has perfectly horizontal lintel and threshold and vertical sides, one slender dark-bronze perimeter frame. INSIDE this opening put uniform neutral charcoal-grey placeholder, with NO view, NO door, NO interior mullions, NO glass reflections: interactive scenery and glazing are composited by the website. To the right of opening, between x=690 and1020, the solid prayer-facing wall has a modest FLAT RECTANGULAR vertical recess, no pointed arch, no scallops, no ornamental trim. A fully visible navy woven prayer mat lies on the floor before that solid wall, head centered about x=845 y=785, foot towards viewer x=900 y=990, with its head facing only the solid wall/recess. No furnishing or opening in its prayer direction. One subtle vertical ribbon of warm timber at the junction of opening and solid wall provides warmth. Ceiling has a broad shallow floating plane, with one fine recessed linear edge light, not a glowing box around the room; soft daylight from left. Warm ivory limestone/plaster, barely perceptible material grain, pale taupe wool carpet, restrained brass/dark-bronze edge details, navy mat with a simple fine ivory border. The room is calm and human, like a beautifully designed airport sanctuary, not a palace, hotel lobby or decorative prayer corner. Keep the right55% mainly empty calm ivory plaster for website search and headline, no objects there. Geometry must feel spatial but composed, left side carefully balanced rather than cluttered. Minimal beautiful architectural realism, believable shadows, matte finishes, excellent natural detail. No text, letters, logos, plants, books, chairs, wall art, candles, arches, people, icons or watermarks. Entire mat and complete threshold visible. Actual generated image only, no UI mockup.
